t: A pocket-sized FPGA board that plays classic games by rebuilding old consoles in hardware.
steps: Buy the Tang Console 60K or 138K from the Sipeed AliExpress store or a marketplace like Newegg.
Get a USB-C cable, a microSD card, and an HDMI cable.
Download the TangCores game distribution and follow its setup guide.
Load a game core and try a homebrew game on your TV.
Install Gowin EDA education edition 1.9.11.03 or newer to design your own circuits.
Open the blink example from the Sipeed Tang Mega examples repo.
Load it with the Gowin programmer and watch the LED blink.
